sec: Adrenal cortex: anatomy, embryology and blood supply · p837

items.q: The adrenal cortex constitutes what percentage of the adrenal gland?
items.exp: The adrenal gland is 80% cortex and 20% medulla, situated on the kidney. (Book p837)

items.q: The fetal : adult adrenal ratio is:
items.exp: Fetal : adult adrenal ratio is 4:1. (Book p837)
At 6 weeks the urogenital ridge (a mesodermal derivative) gives the adrenal primordium (coelomic epithelium). (Book p837)

items.q: Hormone synthesis in the developing adrenal begins at:
items.exp: Hormone synthesis starts at 8 weeks of intra-uterine life. (Book p837)
Note: urine formation begins at 9–10 weeks. (Book p837)
Development is completed at 12 weeks; kidney development completes at 32–36 weeks. (Book p837)
Kidney development is completed by 32–36 weeks. (Book p837)

items.q: The transcription factors listed for adrenal development are:
items.exp: Transcription factors: SF-1, DAX1 (orphan receptors), WNT4. (Book p837)

items.q: Match the suprarenal artery to its origin — 1) Superior suprarenal  2) Middle suprarenal  3) Inferior suprarenal … A) Direct branch of aorta  B) Renal artery branch  C) Inferior phrenic artery branch
items.exp: Superior suprarenal = inferior phrenic branch; middle = direct aortic branch; inferior = renal artery branch. (Book p837)

items.q: Match adrenal venous drainage — 1) Right adrenal vein  2) Left adrenal vein … A) Drains to left renal vein, then IVC  B) Drains directly to IVC
items.exp: Right adrenal vein drains straight to the IVC; left adrenal vein drains to the left renal vein, then IVC. (Book p837)
